projects.name: agent-browser
projects.description: Browser automation CLI for AI agents
projects.readmeExcerpt: agent browser Browser automation for AI agents: open pages, read them as an accessibility tree, and act on elements from the shell. agent browser is a native Rust CLI that gives an AI agent a browser it can drive one command at a time. snapshot returns the page as compact text with a ref such as @e1 for each element. The agent acts on a ref, reads the page again to check the result, and repeats. The browser stays open between commands, so each step is one short shell call. Install Homebrew: brew install agent browser , then agent browser install . Linux: agent browser install with deps also installs the browser's system libraries. No install: npx agent browser open example.com . Project installs, building from source, upgrade , and doctor are covered in Installation. projects.readmeExcerpt: NVIDIA Kubernetes Engine (NVKE) Run a managed Kubernetes service on your own NVIDIA GPU infrastructure. NVIDIA Kubernetes® Engine (NVKE) provides the management plane that platform teams install to create and operate Kubernetes clusters for their customers. Each workload cluster has its own Kubernetes control plane, etcd and node pools. You operate the NVKE management plane; your customers use their clusters through the Kubernetes API and kubectl . Preview: NVKE is available as a preview. APIs, configuration and behavior can change between releases, and we do not recommend NVKE for production workloads. See Preview status and known limitations.
